title: OpenConstruction Benchmark Results Schema
description: Reported leaderboard results for OpenConstruction benchmarks.

subtasks.description: Finer-grained task labels covered by this benchmark; free text today, should be reconciled against task-vocabulary.json.

summary.description: Short lead paragraph rendered under the benchmark title.

benchmark_description.description: Longer prose describing what the benchmark measures. Optional; falls back to summary when absent.

results_url.description: External leaderboard. When present the site links out instead of rendering a local table/figure.

last_updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the reported numbers were last reconciled with the source.

data_note.description: Curator note about gaps, exclusions, or caveats in the reported rows.

hide_year_column.description: Force-hide the Year column even when row years are present (e.g. every row is the same year).

method_column_label.description: Header label for the method column (e.g. "Model", "Large model", "Model / Baseline"). Defaults to "Model".

primary_metric_key.description: metric_columns[].key selected by default in the figure/metric picker.

direction.description: Which way is better. Drives default figure sort direction and the up/down indicator.

row_columns.description: Non-metric row dimensions promoted to real leaderboard-table columns (e.g. model type, family, data combination).

key.description: Result-row property to read (e.g. model_type, model_family, category, data_combination, data_source).

min_width.description: CSS min-width for the rendered column.

position.description: Where the column sits relative to the method column. Default: before_method.

comparison_chart.description: Configuration for the grouped comparison figure. Set {"enabled": false} to suppress it.

metric_keys.description: metric_columns[].key values to plot as grouped series.

category_order.description: Explicit ordering of row groups (matched against a row_columns key or data_source).

method.description: Model / system / baseline name shown in the method column.

model_type.description: Source leaderboard's own class label, transcribed verbatim for display (e.g. "Proprietary", "Open", "Open Source", "Reasoning", "Large", "Human baseline", "Baseline"). Not a controlled value — use `access` for a normalized field.

access.description: Normalized provenance class. Required on every row of a benchmark that classifies entries by provenance (i.e. that sets `model_type`).

category.description: Benchmark-defined bucket for the row (e.g. class-count regime "26" / "14").

data_source.description: Evaluation subset / sensor / split the row was measured on.

data_combination.description: Input-modality combination code used for the row (benchmark-defined, e.g. "T", "ST", "RST").

date.description: Optional finer-grained date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) when year is not specific enough.

source_label.description: Where this row's numbers were reported (paper, leaderboard, repo).

metrics.description: Metric key -> value. number = reported; null = metric applies to this row but the source did not report it; omit the key entirely = metric is not part of this row's evaluation. The string "N/A" is not allowed.
